content.title: No Kings
content.text: In America, we have No Kings.Masked secret police terrorizing our communities. An illegal, catastrophic war putting us in danger and driving up our costs. Attacks on our freedom of speech, our civil rights, our freedom to vote. Costs pushing families to the brink. Trump wants to rule over us as a tyrant. But this is America, and power belongs to the people - not to wannabe kings or their billionaire cronies. On March 28, we show up together, and we say, loud and clear: No Kings. What’s Next?Ready to keep up the momentum? Across the country, people are continuing to meet, organize, and take action in their own communities. Because real change is built by people like you, staying engaged and showing up again and again. Watch the National livestreamNo Kings Flagship Rally at the Minnesota State CapitolMarch 28, 2026 at 3PM EDT / 2PM CDT / 12PM PDT March 28 EventsFrom packed city streets to small-town gatherings, March 28 was a nationwide day of action. See the scale. Feel the momentum. Upcoming Trainings Friday, April 3 at 3:00PM EDTAs hosts, you have power the fight for America. On the Friday after No Kings, over 3,000 hosts will gather together to digest and debrief the historic No Kings activations and plan how to deepen our movement, starting with “What's Next” Organizing Meetings. Monday, April 20 at 8:00PM EDTAbusive immigration enforcement poses a threat to us all but places non-citizens at particular risk. This session will equip participants to train others on core Know Your Rights topics such as the right to remain silent, the right to refuse to consent to searches, and the right to record ICE and other law enforcement officials. We will also cover best practices for reducing risks when exercising rights. [Recording] Tuesday, March 31 at 8:00PM EDTOn March 28, millions of us made it clear: we don't do kings in America. Our nonviolent movement is only growing. At our March 31 Mass Call, you'll hear from leaders and fellow local activists to celebrate this historic mobilization and dig into what comes next. Join us. Tuesday, March 31 at 7:00 PM EDTJoin Interfaith Alliance and partners for a national interfaith town hall to come together in the immediate aftermath of No Kings III, reflect on what we are seeing, and turn this moment into a movement through tangible, ongoing action. The Work Continues America has a long history, rooted in white supremacy, of suppressing the rights of people of color. But our history also clearly shows that people-powered movements are how we end authoritarianism.Throughout 2025, in the face of unprecedented attacks, millions of us joined together in our communities and held the largest single day of morally grounded, nonviolent direct actions by any movement in US history. Each time we show up, we disrupt President Trump’s attempts to rule through repression and remind the country, and the world, that people power is our path to a truly free America.
